title: WF03 f3a inui02 fix: login redirect dropped query params and broke definition filter URL persistence after reload
summary: TC-INUI02-02 failed because a full page reload triggered re-authentication, and login return navigation reconstructed only pathname from ProtectedRoute state. That stripped definitionName/definitionId query params, so the definition filter was lost after reload.

root_cause.details: Login page used location.state.from.pathname only, discarding state.from.search and state.from.hash when navigating after successful login.

changes: Updated web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx to reconstruct post-login target from pathname + search + hash.
Validated frontend checks and reran the failing E2E test TC-INUI02-02 to confirm URL persistence through reload.

prevention: When using React Router location state for auth return paths, always preserve pathname + search + hash.
For URL-state requirements, include reload+re-auth flows in E2E assertions to catch query-loss regressions.
